mapper.select: SELECT h.dev_id,h.work_stts_cd,h.bgn_dt,h.end_dt FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.bgn_dt<=#{end} AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt>=#{start}) AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('RESIGN','VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') ORDER BY h.dev_id,h.bgn_dt,h.work_stts_hist_id

SELECT m.asgn_id,m.work_ym AS month,m.mm_qty AS mm FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym BETWEEN to_char(#{start}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND to_char(#{end}::date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY m.asgn_id,m.work_ym

SELECT t.tmpr_asgn_id AS id,t.need_id,t.dev_id,t.bgn_ym, coalesce(t.end_ym,to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD') + (n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM')) AS end_ym, t.mm_qty AS mth_mm_qty,t.tmpr_asgn_src_cd,t.mtch_scr,t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd AS status,t.asgn_id,o.oppt_nm FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id WHERE t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND t.bgn_ym<=to_char(#{end}::date,'YYYY-MM') AND coalesce(t.end_ym,to_char(to_date(n.bgn_ym || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD') + (n.mnth_qty-1)*interval '1 month','YYYY-MM'))>=to_char(#{start}::date,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY t.tmpr_asgn_id
